items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I met him there and we had this controversy again about the saxophone player, Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: hung out. It was a hang out place. Everybody hung out there during the intermission. Nice bartender named Johnny, and it was a nice place, so I met him there and we had this controversy again about the saxophone player, Charlie Parker. So he finally agreed. I said, 'oh, man, it'll be all right.' And so we made the date. When we got down there he wanted me to sing, B--Tanning from the singing-- this guy gave me a hard time cause I sang a time. what the hell business is it if I get to sing, and when I did sing I…
And he made a big to-do out of that that I shouldn't have been singing, I should have let Parker play more. I'm the one that cause of him being on in the first place
